description: Independent offline identity, startup-policy, arrival, frame-accounting and correctness audit. No tests, builds, decoding or benchmarks were run. All native runs passed; two case-level bitrate coverage results remain inconclusive.

methodology.hashes: All 128 native JSON/CSV/log identities matched plan and results; native JSON equals embedded data. Fixture, reference metadata and command hashes verified. Both copies of all 16 compressed fixture payloads were independently hashed and matched the strict rerun. Baseline and candidate current binary and source aggregate hashes matched captured build provenance; all three replay harness source files match the overlay manifest on both builds.
methodology.frames: Fixture IDs verified 0..units-1 and one expected display each. Replay loop stride equals units; every offered ID 0..offered-1 appears exactly once as a hardware output.
methodology.policy: Timed startup_grace_ms=250; fixed-initial-deadline-v1. Deadline=max(scheduled_arrival_ns+floor(1e9/fps)*16,scheduled_start_ns+250000000). The initial grace floor never moves or renews. Correctness invocations explicitly retain effective grace 0.
methodology.arrival: For all timed rows, scheduled_arrival_ns=scheduled_start_ns+frame_id*floor(1e9/fps), with jitter 0; scheduled epoch never rebased. All first outputs are frame ID0.
methodology.startup_arithmetic: first_output_ns=min(successful sink_entry_ns)-scheduled_start_ns. initial_setup_ns=first admitted frame vt_submit_ns-preparation_end_ns, requiring PREPARATION and VT_SUBMIT bits and ordered timestamps. Both independently derived values equal native and analyzed records. Setup includes several operations and is not isolated VT session-creation time.
methodology.startup_sla: Every timed first output <=250000000 ns from the original scheduled start; distinct from arrival admission deadlines.
methodology.scheduler_events: For all runs, empty event lists and all four reason counters equal zero. Missing CSV identities and scheduler_drops also equal zero, independently confirming event accounting. With no events, this run does not exercise deadline-drop branches.
methodology.correctness: Native comparisons cover W*H*3/2*fixture_units YUV420 code samples per correctness run against independent FFmpeg HEVC references, zero max/mean code error. Metadata/command hashes and raw-reference hash linkage verified; deleted raw reference bytes were not regenerated. IOSurface/Metal and retained-buffer checks passed.
methodology.steady: Every offered ID>=120 delivered; first 120 offered IDs are0..119. Startup and post-warmup losses remain separate delivery checks. No reset, cancellation, rejected input or generation change occurred in any timed trial.
methodology.limits: End-of-trial thermal_state 0 is a snapshot, not continuous telemetry. Native replay does not validate live Qt, rendering, network or presentation. Prior strict results remain valid for their stricter startup admission policy.
